description: Send a plain-text email from your iCloud Mail address (to/cc/bcc, subject, body; no attachments). Body ≤ 20,000 chars, all shown for confirmation. inReplyTo {mailbox, uid} threads a reply ("Re:" subject; quoteOriginal quotes it), warning if the original's Reply-To is not a recipient. Saved to Sent. Needs ICLOUD_USERNAME + ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call performs NO write and returns a preview of exactly what would happen plus a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

bcc.description: Bcc recipients (hidden from the others). Each entry is one address: name@example.com or "Name <name@example.com>".

body.description: The message text (plain text, up to 20000 characters; a longer one is refused, not cut).

cc.description: Cc recipients. Each entry is one address: name@example.com or "Name <name@example.com>".

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

inReplyTo.description: The message this answers (from apple_mail_search): threads the reply to it. It does not choose the recipients; when the original shows a replyTo, check with the user which address to answer.

mailbox.description: Mailbox of the message being answered (default inbox).

uid.description: UID of the message being answered.

uidValidity.description: The mailbox uidValidity returned alongside the uids. When given, the call is refused if the mailbox was renumbered since (an old uid could then name a different message).

quoteOriginal.description: With inReplyTo: append the original text, quoted (default false).

subject.description: Subject line. Required unless inReplyTo is given (then it defaults to "Re: <original subject>").

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for dates you pass and dates returned (default: DISPLAY_TZ).

to.description: Recipients (1–100 across to, cc and bcc). Each entry is one address: name@example.com or "Name <name@example.com>".

name: apple_mail_send
title: Send an email from iCloud Mail
